title: What's Included in a Vinyl Plank Installation Quote in Snohomish?
meta: A real vinyl plank quote in Snohomish lists labor at $2.50 per sq ft, $100 per stair, plus material, prep, removal and trim. Wills Flooring shows each line.
keywords: vinyl plank installation quote, what does LVP installation include, vinyl plank labor cost per square foot, vinyl plank quote breakdown, vinyl plank flooring Snohomish WA

blocks.lead: A complete vinyl plank quote has at least six separate lines: installation labor, stairs, the plank itself with a waste factor, old floor removal, subfloor prep, and transitions and trim. Anything that lumps those together cannot be compared to anything else.
blocks.detail: Wills Flooring's published labor rate is $2.50 per sq ft with a 500 sq ft minimum and $100 per stair. Material, underlayment, removal and prep are measured and quoted at the free in-home estimate, each on its own line, so you can see exactly what you are paying for.

blocks.html: Snohomish homeowners tend to collect three quotes and then find they cannot line them up. One is a single number for "the whole downstairs". One is per room. One is $2.50 per square foot and looks cheapest until the plank, the removal and the trim show up as extras. None of them is necessarily dishonest, but only an itemized quote lets you compare. This post walks through every line we put on a vinyl plank quote, what drives each one in Snohomish houses with crawlspaces, dogs and uneven old floors, and how to read the ones that leave things out.

Underlayment

Most rigid-core plank has an attached pad. If yours does not, or the room needs a vapor barrier over a slab, this is its own line.
Old floor removal

Carpet and pad come up fast; glued sheet vinyl and old tile do not. Haul-away is included in the removal line.
Subfloor prep
Quoted after inspection
Self-leveler over dips, screwing down squeaks, replacing soft plywood, sealing a slab. In Snohomish this is the line that varies most.
Transitions and trim
Per piece or per linear foot
T-moldings, reducers, stair noses and quarter round or shoe molding where baseboards stay.

blocks.text: What the labor number never includes, at any company

items.title: The plank itself
items.text: A $2.50 labor rate is not a $2.50 floor. Plank ranges widely by wear layer and core, and it is often the largest line on the quote. Ask for the product name, wear layer thickness and price per square foot in writing so you can check it against the box.

items.title: Making the floor flat
items.text: Vinyl plank telegraphs every hump and dip. Manufacturers allow about 3/16 in over 10 ft. A 1920s house near downtown Snohomish or a farmhouse on Fobes Hill rarely meets that without leveler, and no one can price leveler until they set a straightedge on the floor.

items.title: Taking out what is there
items.text: Removal is priced by what comes up. Carpet in a Clearview split-level is quick. Two layers of glued vinyl over particleboard in an older kitchen is a half-day of scraping and a subfloor replacement.

items.title: Trim and doors
items.text: New plank changes floor height. Doors may need trimming, baseboards may need shoe molding, and every doorway to a different floor needs a transition. These are small lines, but a quote without them is not finished.

blocks.title: Snohomish crawlspaces change the prep line:
blocks.text: A damp crawlspace pushes moisture up through the subfloor and can lift even waterproof plank at the seams. We check the crawlspace vents and read subfloor moisture at the estimate. If it is high, the quote says so and includes a vapor barrier, rather than letting the floor fail a year later.
Red flags on a vinyl plank quote

items.html: No square footage on the page. "Downstairs" and "three rooms" are not measurements. You cannot check the labor line, and you will not know if the material order is short.
Labor and material blended into one rate. A $6 per sq ft "installed" number hides whether you are getting a 6 mil or a 20 mil wear layer. Ask for the split.
No mention of the subfloor. An installer who never put a straightedge on your floor has either guessed at prep or plans to bill it on install day.
Stairs priced as square footage. A stair takes far longer than a square yard of floor. Per-stair pricing is the honest way; ours is $100 each.
Nothing about waste, transitions or trim. These always exist. If they are missing, they are coming later. Our guide to how long installation takes shows where each one fits in the schedule.

blocks.text: What to ask before you sign

items: What is the measured square footage, and is the labor billed on that number or on the material ordered?
Which product, what wear layer, and how much extra is being ordered for waste?
Did you check the floor with a straightedge and a moisture meter, and what did you find?
Is removal and disposal of the old floor included, and for which rooms?
Which transitions and trim pieces are on the quote, and where does each one go?
Is the 1-year workmanship warranty in writing, and are you licensed and insured?

faq.q: Does the $2.50 per sq ft include the vinyl plank?
faq.a: No. $2.50 per sq ft is Wills Flooring's installation labor, with a 500 sq ft minimum. The plank itself, any underlayment, old floor removal and subfloor prep are separate lines quoted at the free in-home estimate so you can see each cost on its own.

faq.q: How much extra plank should the quote include for waste?
faq.a: Seven to ten percent for a straight lay in normal rooms. Diagonal or herringbone patterns, lots of closets and angled walls push it toward fifteen. The quote should show the square footage ordered, rounded up to full boxes, and you keep the leftovers for future repairs.

faq.q: Why does subfloor prep vary so much between Snohomish houses?
faq.a: Older homes near downtown and farmhouses on acreage have settled floors, sagging joists over crawlspaces and old layers of flooring. A 2000s Clearview house on a flat plywood subfloor may need nothing. Prep can only be priced after someone checks the floor with a straightedge and a moisture meter.

faq.q: Is a per-room quote for vinyl plank a bad sign?
faq.a: Not always, but it hides the square footage, so you cannot compare it to a per-foot quote or check the material order. Ask the installer to convert it to measured square feet with labor and material shown separately. If they will not, treat it as a rough guess.

faq.q: Are stairs included in the square footage?
faq.a: No. Stairs are priced per stair, $100 each at Wills Flooring, because each tread and riser has to be cut, fitted and capped with a stair nose. A staircase of thirteen steps is $1,300 in labor regardless of how the rest of the house is laid out.

faq.q: What happens if the installer finds a problem on install day?
faq.a: It should be rare if the estimate included a real subfloor check. When something is hidden under old flooring, we stop, show you the problem and price the fix before continuing. A quote with a written scope protects you from surprise add-ons that were simply left off.
